s: time for bed / time for sleep
Heia.et: Chiefly Central German word attested since the 18th century. Related to common lullaby verses like heia popeia. This is probably of mere interjectional origin, though some have ventured to derive it from Proto-Indo-European *ḱey- (“to lie down”), in which case…

t: Es ist Zeit für die Heia!
Ich bin müde, ich glaube, ich geh' in die Heia.
I'm tired; I think I'm going to go to bed.
l: Vielleicht sowas wie: aaah – do schaun ma hoid a moi – jetzt machma erstamoi a Moratorium, weil heia kemma uns des sowieso ned leistn.
